en.bilal-muhammad: Al-Husayn b. Ahmad b. Idris (ra) narrated to us. He said: Al-Husayn b. Ishaq al-Tajir narrated to us from `Ali b. Mahziyar from Fadala b. Ayyub from Isma`il b. Abi Ziyad from Abi `Abdillah al-Sadiq (as) from his forefathers (as). He said:
The Messenger of Allah (s) said: Whoever wishes for a thing whilst being pleased with Allah will not leave this world until he is granted it.
